syllabus_topics: Generation of Pneumatic and Hydraulic Energy
Selection of Pneumatic and Hydraulic components
teaching_methods: Individual or group work, problem-solving and lab reports
Personal interviews with the course professor
Practical sessions (simple assemblies on panels, circuit analysis on computer, component sizing exercises)
Pneumatics project (design and build a machine for process automation)

assessment_methods.method: Pneumatics Project (Group Deliverables related to milestones)
Pneumatics Project (Proper functioning of process automation)

assessment_rules: For the ordinary examination, a minimum mark of 4/10 is required in the Exam on Pneumatics, and a minimum average mark of 4/10 is required in the Exams on Oil Hydraulics to pass the subject. Students who withdraw from working on the project with their peers will receive a 0% in the Pneumatics Project. Not attending or displaying indifferent behavior in practical sessions will result in a loss of grade. In the extraordinary examination, students will take a written exam on the parts of the subject in which the minimum required mark was not reached. The final mark will be calculated similarly to the ordinary examination, retaining marks from passed parts.
